#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:**

When
 the Divine
 operative wisdom descended into the created order,
 it
 bore
 with
 it three degrees of accommodated truth:
 truth as rational understanding, truth as the
 expression of love, and truth as natural
 knowledge. These
 it
 assumed
 from the Divine origin and
 cloth
ed itself
 within
 them
.
 Through these three degrees of external truth it
 established order among all spiritual states, both
 interior and exterior,
 and
 arranged them so that the Divine could be
 manifested through successive
 cov
erings. Afterward, having
 accomplished
 its works
 of
 ordering
, it laid
 aside these external accommod
ations in the presence of those dwelling
 in states of genuine good — revealing to
 them the naked
 interior
 realities that the truths had ve
iled.

**¶2:**

When it
 was about to release these
 degrees
, it loosened them from their point
 of conjunction and withdrew itself from within them
. And
 so
 these three degrees of accommodated truth are
 disposed in order,
 extending from the outermost boundary of
 the limiting state between
 what
 is
 interior and what is exterior,
 encompassing all things
 within that
 boundary
. From above, at the most interior
 point, the limiting boundary itself
 is removed; and what had served as
 the outermost covering is set beneath
 the
 interior
 re
alities and
 then elevated
 back toward
 the heights from which it had originally proceeded
 —
 returning
 to the Divine origin from
 which it was
 first sent forth
 at
 the beginning of
 all ordering
.

---

*Note
: The
 "
zone
" —
 the cosmic
 belt or boundary — corresponds
 to the lim
inal state separ
ating discrete
 degrees
.
 Its
 removal
 "
at its topmost point" describes
 the opening
 of infl
ux when
 the accommod
ating
 form
 is no
 longer needed
:
 truth
 returns
 to its source.*
